description: arXiv:2609.22195v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models can convincingly adopt personas, recall past dialogues, and weave rich autobiographies. Yet this conversational eloquence conceals a fundamental attribution problem: looking the part does not mean having lived the life. Two individuals can share identical public profiles--the same age, hometown, occupation, and personality...
author: Jun He, Deying Yu
